consequence.statement: The UI label change has no operational consequence; the SYNC STATUS view's filter will display a renamed label but functionality remains unchanged.

original.statement: The filter message status label on the SYNC STATUS view was renamed in the Argo CD UI.

decision.reason: [ev-80ec0aaa2676] lists this only as a UI feature that renames a filter message status in the SYNC STATUS view. It names no configuration, API, resource or behaviour that would fail, be rejected or stop working. A UI text rename leaves operators nothing to do, so the "none"/informational consequence fits. The evidence does not give the old or new label, which is why confidence is low.
